title.narrative: CHASE HUNGER AND POVERTY: Diversifying food systems for food and nutrition security, poverty reduction and inclusive development in Northern Uganda

description.narrative: The current CHASE POVERTY AND HUNGER initiative echoes the GOU/EUs ambitions of consolidating stability, reducing poverty and eradicating hunger and malnutrition in Northern Uganda. The objectives respond to the 3 priorities of the Call guidelines which are also well detailed in the DINU scoping study document. The action is grounded on three Result Areas and 7 Main Activity Clusters namely 1) increasing the diversity, productivity and production of crop and animal product; 2) established networks of platforms (the village super market for low-cost access to inputs and produce markets; 3; promoting village savings and credit schemes for increased participation of value chain actors in the monetary economy for inclusive growth 4) forging or strengthening linkages across actors in the in the selected commodity value chains; 5) promoting Business to Business (B2B) match-making models to promote contract farming for effective market access; 6) establish and consolidate agriculture-health nexus in district and community advisory services; and 7) establish communities of active practitioners of inclusive family planning and responsible child spacing in the Acholi and Lango sub-regions
